subject.description: The 目 column: its code and name.

subject_amounts.description: The amount columns of the 目 (and of the 計 row of the 項), with their printed heading.

setsu.description: The 節 区分 column: the 節 code and name.

setsu_amount.description: The 節 金額 column and its heading in the shared dictionary.

explanation.description: The 計上説明 column: the 財源内訳 blocks and the explanation.

item_amount_left.description: An explanation item's amount ends right of this x (it is set at the right end of the line).

marker_reach.description: How far right of the explanation column's left edge an item marker may start.

markers.description: The item markers, one pattern per depth from the top (a whole word: `1`, `⑴`, `ア`).

funding_rule.description: A vertical rule in this x range crosses each 財源内訳 band (and no explanation line).

note_kinds.description: A word of an explanation line and the kind of the monetary note it prints (`債務負担行為額`: 債務負担行為).

total_label.description: The label of the 項 total row in the 目 column.

wrap_reach.description: How far left of item_amount_left the amount of an item whose name wrapped may end (a deeper item's amount ends further in).

marker_edges.description: The right bound of the left edge of each depth's markers, from the top: an item's depth is where its marker starts (a misprinted `２` at the place of `⑵` is the second depth).
